title: Welcome to formed labs
note: Two lanes run through this and they never cross. TRAINING is what the coaches do. RESEARCH is what the lab does. A coach never connects a training goal to a compound; the only door between the lanes is a link to the batch registry. Sheets art (18 Sep 2026): three Nova frames for the Build my week, Fix today and Cook sheets, outside the story order. v108 (19 Sep 2026): the four roster cards are the one neon ring (assets/story/rings/, cut by theregimen-ios/cut-rings.mjs); the old full-frame cards are -hero frames. `screens` maps a screen to the one frame it carries in its One Big Thing, each frame on one screen only, never on a Peptides screen, never beside a compound. `sheets.titan-kane.session` is the Log-a-session sheet. v120: the frames placed by skill and marketing grab (design/FRAMES-PLAN.md); no cartoon frame on any surface.
